title: Toy Story. Woody and Buzz.
lines: In a bedroom full of toys lives a boy called Andy.
Andy has lots and lots of toys.
A pink piggy bank, a dinosaur, a potato man and a dog with a spring for a body.
But his very favourite toy is Woody.
Woody is a cowboy.
He has a brown hat, a yellow shirt and a string on his back.
When you pull it, he says: There's a snake in my boot!
And do you know the secret of all those toys?
When Andy isn't there, they come to life!
Then they talk, and walk, and play with each other.
But as soon as someone comes in, flop, they lie very still again.
One day it's Andy's birthday.
He gets a big present.
He rips off the paper.
And there he is: a space ranger!
He's white and green and purple, with wings on his back and a button on his arm.
Buzz Lightyear!
Andy shouts happily.
He puts Buzz on his bed, in the spot where Woody always lies.
When Andy is gone, Buzz stands up.
He looks around.
This is Buzz Lightyear, he says in a deep voice.
My spaceship has landed on a strange planet.
Woody rolls his eyes.
You're not a real space ranger, he says.
You're a toy, just like us.
But Buzz doesn't believe it.
He thinks he can really fly.
To infinity and beyond!
he shouts.
All the toys think Buzz is amazing.
Woody doesn't like that.
Andy always plays with Buzz now.
Woody feels forgotten.
He is jealous.
One day Andy goes to a pizza restaurant with his mum.
Woody and Buzz secretly go along.
But they argue in the car.
And suddenly they're lost, far away from Andy, in a big car park.
Oh no, says Woody.
This is all my fault.
They end up in the house of the boy next door, Sid.
Sid isn't nice to toys.
He does strange things with them.
Woody and Buzz are scared.
On TV Buzz sees an advert for toys.
For Buzz Lightyear toys.
Then he understands.
I really am a toy, he says softly.
I can't really fly.
He is very sad.
Woody sits down next to him.
Buzz, he says, you are a toy.
But you're Andy's toy.
And that's the most important thing there is.
Andy loves you.
Buzz looks up.
He smiles a little.
Woody, he says, then we have to go back to Andy together!
But Andy is moving house.
The removal van is already leaving!
Woody and Buzz run outside.
They jump onto a toy car.
They drive down the street, after the removal van.
But the car is too slow.
Woody has an idea.
Buzz, your wings!
Buzz presses the button.
His wings pop open.
Woody holds on to him tightly.
They jump into the air, and they fly, or actually they fall, but beautifully and with style, straight to Andy's car.
Plop!
They land in a box, next to Andy.
Andy looks.
Woody!
Buzz!
There you are!
He hugs them both.
Woody and Buzz look at each other and wink.
From that day on Woody and Buzz are best friends.
Andy plays with both of them.
And when the light goes out, Buzz whispers: To infinity.
And Woody whispers back: And beyond!
The end.
